visual_description: A rugged aluminum scaffolding system bolted directly into the sandstone butte. The platform has a slip-resistant metal grate floor and safety toe-boards to prevent tools from falling on people below. A heavy-duty pulley system is attached to the top frame for hauling up plaster and water.

constraints.logic: Provides a stable 'Z-axis' workspace for vertical bones.
constraints.background: Bolted into a stratified orange-red sandstone cliff.
